# Champion Termite & Pest Control

> Veteran-owned termite and pest control company based in Groves, Texas (4601 Bellaire Ave, Groves, TX 77619; 409-209-2091). Serving Beaumont, Port Arthur, Nederland, Port Neches, Groves, Orange, Vidor, Lumberton, Silsbee, Bridge City, Hamshire and Winnie — the Golden Triangle of Southeast Texas — since 2019. Licensed by the Texas Department of Agriculture Structural Pest Control Service. BBB A+ accredited. Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm.

## Services
- [Termite Control & Treatment](https://championtermiteandpest.com/termite-control/): in-ground baiting systems, liquid barrier treatments, combination programs and pre-construction treatments.
- [WDI Inspections](https://championtermiteandpest.com/wdi-inspections/): wood-destroying insect reports for Texas real estate closings, pre-listing inspections, treatment and clearance letters.
- [General Pest Control](https://championtermiteandpest.com/pest-control/): quarterly and monthly programs for roaches, ants, spiders and common household pests.
- [Mosquito Control](https://championtermiteandpest.com/mosquito-control/): barrier spray treatments for Southeast Texas humidity.
- [Rodent Control](https://championtermiteandpest.com/rodent-control/): inspection, baiting and trapping for rats and mice.
- [Commercial Pest Control](https://championtermiteandpest.com/commercial-pest-control/): restaurants, warehouses, offices and multi-unit properties.
- [Bee & Wasp Removal](https://championtermiteandpest.com/bee-wasp-removal/): stinging insect nest removal.
- [Lawn Pest Treatments](https://championtermiteandpest.com/lawn-pest-treatments/): fire ants, chinch bugs, fleas and ticks.
